blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Есть ___ (достойный) и моложе меня, пусть послужат.
exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "**-ее**" (sometimes shortened to "**-ей**") to the stem of the adjective: **новый** — **новее**; **красивый** — **красивее**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80, 82.  ·  From Лев Толстой, «Анна Каренина».
